label: TEST - Flux CSV parser (restore)
info:
Companion test flow for wherewhen_data_restore_flow.json (PLAN.md §2's standing rule) — exercises n_wdr_parse_csv_to_lines' CSV-to-line-protocol logic in isolation against a hand-built fixture matching InfluxDB's DOCUMENTED annotated CSV format, since this logic could not be verified against a real InfluxDB response during development (flagged as the riskiest part of the whole flow in its own tab info).

This test is NOT equivalent to real verification — it confirms the parser does what it's DESIGNED to do against a fixture built from documentation, not that the documentation itself matches every real response shape InfluxDB actually produces (multiple table blocks, unusual tag combinations, etc.). Re-run this after any change to the parser logic; but treat a real backup/restore cycle against a live InfluxDB instance as the actual proof, not this test passing.
